title: Dispatch RFU 9: Weaver Court Receives a New Drain and an Old Name
summary: The upward rain has ended; its recovered objects remain.
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: The council has marked the reopened culvert on its maps and restored the name Old Weaver Street to the archival plan beneath the court. The cloud has vanished. No further possessions have risen, and the Institute has removed its barriers.

Jonah is living with Mrs. Marr while arrangements are made for his care. He asked yesterday whether the street will be rebuilt. She told him it would not, then took him to see where its water now reaches the river. The key recovered from the cloud still fits no known door.
